validation.ordinary_reward_comparison: Manifest and ordinary synthetic-task reward maps match on the same public input with assertions=[]; the default partial-credit scalar is 0 and does not represent success or an original benchmark scalar.
validation.reload_rescore: Serialized WireEpisode reload preserved reward maps and findings for every fresh case.
validation.source_fingerprint_method: Each fresh case records native HEAD, dirty-source diff hash and exact module SHA256 maps before and after execution; same-run fingerprints match. The historical file-hash mismatch is preserved in validation_history, not treated as current evidence.

assumptions_and_boundaries: Public pack only; no heldout/reference assertions, outcomes, traces, rollouts or score used.
Drafts are outcome-only with an empty credit list. Action credit is not measured or implied.
Genuine handler controls use synthetic native receipt envelopes made from exact public task inputs; they are not native reference replay or whole-task qualification.
The ordinary benchmark reward comparison uses the same synthetic fixture and empty public-only assertions; it is not an original benchmark scalar comparison.
Only explicitly supported public facts and source-backed component outcomes are checked.

validation_history.reason: The earlier remaining_controls index referenced handler material and native episode hashes that no longer matched the same-named files after a later broad rerun overwrote them. A targeted filesystem search found no retained copies matching those recorded hashes. The old review and hash index are preserved as historical but its raw/wire evidence is not currently byte-verifiable.
